summary: Full v3 regression on Stock Intel Bot Pass-A (6 features). 17/17 new v3 pytest cases pass + 28/28 v1/v2 regression still green (45/45 backend). Congressional dataset, squeeze 0-100, FY status (correctly inactive in Jan), time-target future-clamp, NLQ webhook catch-all, 9 new/updated Telegram commands, and scan v3 schema (per-result squeeze/time_target/fy_multiplier_applied) all verified. Frontend dashboard renders all 9 required data-testids, new SQUEEZE + TIME columns in scan table, Squeeze Leaderboard panel (top 10, sorted desc), Congressional Buys panel (12 rows, +3PTS MATCH badges on committee-matched buys), CONGRESS_BUY badge on $LMT/$BWXT/$RTX, and FY banner correctly HIDDEN (Jan outside Jul-Sep).
